scope: Maintained fuel only (no depletion or recovery: that is the finite-fuel case's acceptance, D176 item 2). The K+ counterion only, at 5e-10 m/s (Cl- at lysosomal values and every ionic pore wait for the implicit patch). A lumped population of N = 1000 identical compartments as one node, declared; the single-compartment form is reported, not judged, in version 1 (a later version may judge it once species-scaled energy floors exist). Fixed volume (no water). The cytosol's pH within its fuel band (7.2 ± 0.05). Explicit ARS(2,2,2) at the world's declared dt; no implicit patch in this rung. The verdict covers cell_owned_compartments@1 as built at the judged snapshot (refusal 4 version 1.2, refusal 5 version 1.1)

rules.dt_study: S5's form, as D150's and MG0c's: per record, the step term |q(dt) - q(dt/2)|, and the observed orders log2 of successive max-norm differences on the three finest rungs; the rule detects bias, not order. Each difference has its floor F = N eps max|q| (N the finer rung's steps). On the two judged differences: resolved (both >= F) lies in [1.8, 2.2]; at rounding (both < F) passes; mixed (the coarser >= F, the finer < F) passes unless the implied lower bound log2(coarser difference / finer floor) exceeds 2.2; reversed (the coarser < F, the finer >= F) fails; each observable's class is reported with its differences and floors (pre-run correction, the lead, 15 November 2026)
rules.state_error: at the declared 1 ms, the Richardson-estimated error of the pH at every buffered node, the lumen and the cytosol (the maximum over both), <= 1e-3 pH units and of V_b <= 1e-3 of its range (pre-run correction, the lead, 15 November 2026)
rules.reference: at 1 ms against the independent reference, within J4's budget of 1e-3 pH: the declared physical accuracy, the same as J3's. Basis: the references agent's measured floor on this world (about 5e-14 pH) shows the reference resolves that budget by about ten orders of magnitude; a multiple of the floor would sit far below the engine's own discretisation error at 1 ms, so J4 could never pass (the coordinator's corrected ruling, 15 November)
rules.envelope: the closure's estimated first-order lag behind the kinetic system, (rho/lambda)(beta/ln 10 - h)/(h ln 10), within 1e-3 pH at every stage of every buffered node (rapid_proton_buffer.lag_estimate_ph). The engine refuses the step at the first stage beyond it (B4's stage check), so a completed part has none and a refusal fails the part; it reports the running maximum of the estimate over every stage (proton_buffer_max_lag_pH, gap 7) as the margin (pre-run correction, the lead, 15 November 2026). Revised before registration: the FR-4 references' run 02 showed the earlier fixed ratio lambda >= 1e3 rho does not imply the budget (it passes from k_on 0.83 /mM/s, the budget only from about 1.28e4)
rules.ledgers: material per species within its allowance at every record: the declared floor plus N eps max over records of the species' total over the cell, the lumen and the bath (N the run's steps), computed by the judge from the records and reported per species (pre-run correction, the lead, 15 November 2026); charge within the capacitor tolerance; energy residual over flows <= 2e-3 at 1 ms (today's booking), falling at second order down the ladder (the classes, with no upper edge)
rules.bands: the cytosol's pH within 7.2 ± 0.05 at every stage (the pump's domain refuses otherwise)
rules.judged_run: once, after registration, from a fresh clean execution snapshot of the integrated candidate (validation/source_snapshot.py)
rules.attempts: an attempt that ends by infrastructure before its verdict is written is not a verdict; a refusal by the engine is a verdict

controls.K1_no_counterion: the same world with P_K = 0 (World().control()): the lumen's pH falls by less than 0.1 units in 900 s, against more than 1 unit with the route; the references agent confirms the effect exceeds the declared budget (D176's G3)
controls.K2_planted_sign: a self-consistent reversed pump (the lead's ruling (b), 15 November 2026), defined physically: the declared world with its pump's two sides exchanged in the law. The same population on the bounding patch (capacity k, n = 2, K_H, K_ATP, the held fuel at the cytosol, availability 1) hydrolyses one ATP at the cytosol per forward cycle and moves n H+ from the lumen to the cytosol. Its cycle free energy is dG_cyc = d_rG'_ATP + n [RT ln(h_c/h_L) + F V_b], with V_b = phi_c - phi_L and h_c, h_L the free protons; its rate is J = k a S (1 - exp(dG_cyc/RT)), S = [1 + (K_H/h_L)^n]^-1 [1 + K_ATP/c_ATP]^-1, saturating on the lumen's free proton, the side it takes protons from. Per cycle: the lumen's H_eq -n and the cytosol's +n, a charge n e from the lumen to the cytosol; heat -J dG_cyc >= 0; the maintenance's work -J d_rG'_ATP. Every ledger closes, so only J4 can catch it: it must fail by more than its budget, and the independent reference computes its trajectory and records that its effect exceeds the budget (D176's G3). The pump's moves flipped alone (+n per forward cycle) are refused by the engine's material ledger: a unit guard in the tests, not a judged control
controls.K3_closure_outside: the lumen buffer's k_on lowered to 1e-3 mM-1 s-1 (1 M-1 s-1): the engine refuses the world at the definition through the envelope check (its initial lag estimate about 1e4 pH; the reason the envelope's, since the same world is admitted with B4's stage check removed), and in the kinetic reference the closure departs beyond 1e-3 pH units

guards_of_record.species_only: a species-only guard world (D150's form) where the closure and the leak are the only energy flows, judged at rounding
guards_of_record.delta_g_per_law: a NumPy dG test per law per step (the kernels' contract tests, extended to the wired step)

reported_not_judged: the single-compartment form's ledger floors (C8 of the charged-patch analysis: H at about 1.6 free ions at pH 7.4)

disclosures: The declared step (1 ms, max-side 0.025) and the K+ permeability (5e-10 m/s) were chosen with the charged-patch test's runs 02-04 in view: explicit steps were refused by the energy booking above about 0.09 (log-mean) on worlds with no pump or buffer, so the 0.05 world-declared limit and its factor-of-two margin are extrapolations this protocol's dt study tests
The K+ counterion replaced Cl- after the same runs showed lysosomal Cl- needs 0.01-0.03 ms explicitly
The lumped population (N = 1000) was chosen after the floor arithmetic (CP4) showed a single compartment's pump energy sits within 6% of the absolute energy floor

The closure's envelope lost its dt clause after the advisor's check that §13's inside case would otherwise leave it near steady state; the 1e3 ratio and the 1e-3 pH budget were fixed before any comparison exists
The buffers' pK values, k_on and the pump's constants are generic declarations, not fits; no run of this world has been made
The dt ladder (2, 1, 0.5, 0.25 ms) was chosen with the 0.05 threshold in view, so that the coarsest rung sits at it

The envelope check was revised before any run of this world, after the FR-4 references' run 02 found that the fixed ratio admitted k_on = 1e3 with a 1.26e-2 pH lag; the revised check is the state-dependent lag estimate, with that case kept as a planted test

Absent rows: the world declares a 1e-9 mM trace (background 1e-9 mM, floor 1e-18 fmol) wherever a row does not apply, since absent rows are refused; the independent references use an exact 0 for the absent buffer. This is a declared difference: the closure's mask keys on the declared (node, row) pairs, so the traces are never live buffers, and their effect on the compared quantities is reported
